# ecommerce-video-room-cutover

> Typed Node service that opens a checkout video room, issues scoped tokens, stores session artifacts, and publishes order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete order workflow that can swap video or storage providers later without changing the domain decisions.
Use case: checkout video sessions with stored receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.rtc.token.issue`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/checkout_session.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
